description: CFAH-15 (OSF preprint) AP-93: death of Hammurabi, 989 BC.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 989 BC (AP-93, OSF preprint CFAH-15)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-15: Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon," OSF preprint v1.4 (2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/VYNJU, file "CFAH-15 Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon_v1.4.pdf", p. 28
chronologies.note: CFAH-15 p. 28: "Therefore, we have a triangulation for the Death of Hammurabi in 989 BC, new Anchor Point #93." OSF preprint, not peer-reviewed in ARJ; see docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS-FOR-KEVIN.md on whether preprint anchor points should set tier 1. Conventional (middle) chronology has Hammurabi die c. 1750 BC; CFAH is roughly 760 years later.
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.
